name: 紅翅鳳頭鵑
illustrationTaxon: Clamator coromandus adult breeding plumage: black peaked crest, narrow white hind collar, orange-buff throat, chestnut-red wings, pale belly, long graduated black tail

similarSpecies.distinction: 褐翅鴉鵑是體型更大的鴉鵑，黑身與栗褐翼，沒有白色後頸環或尖長冠；紅翅鳳頭鵑較纖長，頭冠、白環及橙喉醒目。
雄噪鵑全身黑亮、紅眼，沒有栗紅翼、白色後頸環與長冠；紅翅鳳頭鵑具黑冠、白環、橙喉和栗紅翼。

featureNotes: 成鳥冠羽黑色而突出，輪廓尖長
黑色頭部後方有窄白領環，喉為橙淡褐
覆羽至飛羽呈醒目的栗紅色
尾長且漸層，黑色帶細白羽端

rangeMap.note: Partial native-range overview: breeds from northern India and Nepal east through Myanmar and parts of Indochina to southern/eastern China; winters in central/southern India, Sri Lanka, the Thai-Malay Peninsula and parts of maritime Southeast Asia. Country highlights are a broad seasonal range overview, not nationwide occupancy, precise range polygons, or Hong Kong occurrences. In Hong Kong it is an uncommon summer visitor and scarce passage migrant, using closed-canopy shrubland, forest and other wooded habitats.

sources.use: Full HKBWS Chestnut-winged Cuckoo account read: Category I; uncommon summer visitor and scarce passage migrant. Adults 45–47 cm; black head with prominent crest, narrow white hind collar, black mantle/tail, chestnut-red wings, mostly whitish underbody with orange-buff throat patch, reddish-brown iris, black bill/legs. Occurs in wooded habitats; breeding-season survey suggests distributional decline in Hong Kong. Range and local seasonality; IUCN LC, population trend stable.

Cornell eBird/Merlin species account read: peaked black crest, bright orange throat, rusty wings, black back, white nape and belly; dense canopy foraging; varied metallic/raspy calls. Used as a cross-check for adult identification.
HKBWS Greater Coucal account (full account previously read for 0076): larger, long-tailed coucal; glossy black body, orange-brown wings and reddish-brown eye; used to distinguish comparator.
Cornell eBird Greater Coucal comparison: large coucal with rusty wings, black body and red eyes.
Cornell eBird Asian Koel species account; adult male glossy black, red eye, no chestnut wings or white nape collar; comparator image is the previously reviewed adult male illustration.
